name: 不锈钢可调加厚承重柜脚款
description: 不锈钢柜脚可调高度，加厚承重防滑防锈，多家具通用

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating deep charcoal photographic scene panels #2B2B2D and clean white infographic panels #FFFFFF with light grey #F5F5F5 section fill; dark sections may use a near-black #1E1E20 depth layer
styleLock.lightingSystem: low-key directional soft light with controlled brushed-metal specular highlights on dark scene panels; flat even high-key light on infographic panels; always a soft contact shadow under the product
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte charcoal walls, wood-grain furniture tops and wooden floor planks for scenes; pure white or light grey graphic panels for info screens
styleLock.typography: bold modern sans-serif only; red capsule label chips, large charcoal headlines on white panels and white headlines on dark panels; short two-line labels under icons
styleLock.iconSystem: solid vermilion #D5281F circular icons with thin white line glyphs; thin red leader-line callouts with small labels
styleLock.presentationRules: stable eye-level or low-angle product views; brushed steel keeps controlled specular highlights; capsule label and white card label styles stay identical across the set; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
noDrift: no added brand marks, QR codes or membership badges
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent hardware-ecommerce infographic visual system across the entire set; fixed palette of pure white info panels #FFFFFF, deep charcoal scene panels #2B2B2D, light grey section fill #F5F5F5, and one vermilion red accent #D5281F for capsule labels, round icons and callouts; neutral temperature; bold modern sans-serif headlines with rounded capsule label chips; alternating dark photographic scene sections and clean white infographic sections; solid red circular icons with thin white line glyphs; product rendered as brushed stainless steel with controlled specular highlights and a soft contact shadow; stable product scale, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins, thin red leader-line callouts; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 源为 750 宽详情页长图，按 800x1200 切片 15 片逐片拼合分析（相邻 60px 重叠）。主产品为不锈钢可调柜脚（家具五金调整脚），与源文件名一致；归类按 taxonomy 精确串入 家装灯具/五金。已剥离：店铺会员二维码与引流标签、源场景白卡上的英文装饰文案与独特排版、所有具体参数数字（源图数字本身已打码，模板统一改为 {callout} 文案槽位由使用方填写）、品牌类元素；六宫格/安装步骤等文案全部按卖点重建。源长图中段多处产品渲染图因压缩过暗不可读，仅保留其版式结构与可见文案。
